scale_conventions.rate_unit: per exposure-year (Exposure capped at 1 by clean)
scale_conventions.frequency: annual claim rate; expected claim count = rate * Exposure
scale_conventions.severity: expected capped cost per claim (S_cap / N scale)
scale_conventions.pure_premium: annual capped cost rate (S_cap / Exposure scale); expected capped cost = rate * Exposure; freq x sev candidates: frequency rate * severity
scale_conventions.glm: rate = exp(intercept + sum_j design_ij coef_j) of the stored model on features.transform with the stored feature map (per-row reduction: row-order invariant)
scale_conventions.gbm: rate = exp(raw score), raw_score=True never includes an init score; expected counts = exp(raw + log Exposure) computed explicitly
scale_conventions.capped: capped prediction = expected capped-claim cost, never a truncation

evaluation.nonfinite_policy: fail closed: a non-finite or non-positive prediction, a non-finite loss or metric, a zero or non-finite denominator, or a non-finite bootstrap replicate aborts the attempt; nothing is dropped
evaluation.technical_rerun_policy: A technical rerun (protocol section 6) is allowed only after an attempt that has TEST_OPENED but no COMPLETE (a crash, I/O error or environment problem), only with the same manifest digest and the same runtime identity, as a deterministic replay with no model, config or code-path change; it needs --technical-rerun --reason, is recorded linked to the failed attempt and is logged as an amendment of the protocol. A completed attempt is never rerun. Every attempt, failed ones included (error type only, no metric), is listed in the journal and reported.
evaluation.recovery_policy: Outputs are written to a private staging directory, validated (finite values, expected keys) and hashed; the COMPLETE event records the hashes; only then are they published to results/test/attempt-<n>/ and the results/metrics.json pointer. If publication fails after COMPLETE, `fremtpl2 evaluate --publish-only` republishes the staged outputs without recomputing and fails closed on a hash mismatch. Completion is never inferred from a directory or pointer. `fremtpl2 evaluate --rehearsal` runs the identical code path on a train CV fold before test access.

rehearsal.population: train rows with cv_fold == freeze.rehearsal.fold (never cv_fold < 0)
rehearsal.note: identical evaluate code path; outputs under paths.processed only
